statement: Run15-style mixed priority-recovery operation context selection chooses the still-open dispatch-pending row for owner progress when a terminal REMOVED sibling has newer terminal evidence, without broad ACTIVE discounts or parent statistical closure.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not re-dispatch terminal REMOVED/FAILED rows; the target is selecting or reentering the still-open nonterminal owner row when mixed contexts exist.
Do not claim the parent rolling-restart run4 Wilson closure bar from this Quest.

doneWhenSealed.closure: A focused priority-recovery snapshot regression proves mixed operation contexts for one priority partition select the actionable nonterminal PENDING row for dispatch-pending owner progress, rather than letting a newer terminal REMOVED sibling produce terminal wait_for_operation_progress. The fix must preserve terminal-only completion behavior and must not broaden ACTIVE/post-rebalance discounts. The parent rolling-restart statistical bar remains unchanged.
